judgment_methodology.method: USE Method (Utilization/Saturation/Errors) as the diagnostic lens for a resource bottleneck

planning_methodology.method: SLO-driven capacity planning per the Google SRE book's monitoring/SLO chapters

deliverable_form.method: RED-method (Rate/Errors/Duration) benchmark report with before/after latency numbers

feedback_methodology.method: Tail-latency review: does the change report p99/p999, not only mean latency
feedback_methodology.source: Dean & Barroso, "The Tail at Scale," Communications of the ACM, 2013; research.google/pubs/pub40801

review_methodology.method: Azure Well-Architected performance-testing checklist applied before sign-off (baseline, load, soak)

reference_resolution.rule: sli must resolve to an actual monitored metric — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2). Each axis_evaluation ref must resolve to a real entry inside this record carrying axis (must be in this role's judgment_axes), verdict (supports|contradicts|no-opinion), and citation (a docs/product/*.md entry path); when verdict is contradicts, the entry must also carry a finding object with target_path (must resolve against some role's write_scope) and a non-empty required_fix (issue-573 architecture proposal, sections 1 and 6).

gate_c_axis_evaluation: see docs/handbooks/architecture-methodology.md, section 'Axis evaluation procedure — performance' for the READ/EXECUTE/CRITERIA/CITATION method this role's axis_evaluation entries must follow: EXECUTE recomputes error_budget_remaining from the current sli measurement against slo_target, then recomputes verdict from that recomputed budget, per the Google SRE Workbook (implementing-slos / error-budget-policy chapters).

recomputation.rule: error_budget_remaining is recomputed from the current sli measurement against slo_target, never a standalone asserted field.
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

quality_bar.verification_method: reuses the spec's existing gate_c_axis_evaluation measurement rule: declared SLO plus a measured value against it
error-budget calculation (SRE workbook policy) against the measured value for the declared SLO window
p99 percentile latency measurement from the same load test/measurement run, stated against a bound
resource-utilization measurement (CPU/memory/connections, USE method) alongside the latency measurement, headroom against the current capacity ceiling stated

use_when.board_condition: a latency- or throughput-sensitive change lands on the branch AND no performance-engineering record exists yet for that commit sha
